facebook.caption:
POV: you took a wrong turn in Phu Quoc's jungle and found a waterfall instead.

Fairy Waterfall is one of those spots that rewards people who actually leave the beach for a few hours. 4.3 stars across 223 reviews. Not a massive crowd-puller, which is exactly the point.

Wear shoes you don't mind getting wet. Bring water. Go early.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
facebook.video_caption: Jungle path. Rushing water. Zero beach crowds. Fairy Waterfall delivers on all of it. 4.3 stars and most tourists still walk straight past it. Don't be that tourist.
